basics.name: Yunus Emre Danabaş
basics.label: Undergraduate Student in Mechatronics & Electronics Engineering
basics.summary: I am a fourth-year undergraduate at Sabancı University pursuing a double major in Mechatronics and Electronics Engineering. With a strong academic record (CGPA 3.77, ranked 3rd in my cohort) and extensive hands-on experience in robotics, control systems, and embedded technologies, I am passionate about applying my skills to innovative research and practical solutions in robotics.

education.description: Ranked 3rd among 33 seniors. Awarded Full Scholarship and Extracurricular Student Activities Leadership Awards in 2023 and 2024.

work.name: Sabancı University
work.position: Teaching Assistant for Prof. Volkan Patoğlu
work.summary: Assisting in 'ME312 Analysis and Synthesis of Mechanisms' and 'ME403 Introduction to Robotics', including instruction of 20+ students per semester, weekly office hours, and project supervision.

work.name: Munich Institute of Robotics and Machine Intelligence (TUM MIRMI)
work.summary: Investigated force and moment scaling in robotic force-torque sensors; designed and fabricated flexure hinge prototypes using MATLAB and SolidWorks; conducted experimental tests and developed digital twins in Gazebo for assessing system stability and dynamic response.

work.name: TÜBİTAK BİLGEM
work.summary: Enhanced ROS skills through formal training and performed comparative analyses of single and multi-robot simulations using Gazebo and RViz.

work.name: Pubinno Inc.
work.summary: Designed 3D-printed prototypes using OnShape, led the development of an automated maintenance prototype, and coordinated quality control activities.

volunteer.summary: Managed financial matters, budgets, and coordinated seminars, reading groups, and mathematics competitions.
Narrated audiobooks for visually impaired individuals to enhance accessibility.

projects.name: Data-Driven Control of Exoskeletons
projects.summary: Developing a control system for exoskeletons using data-driven optimization and human-in-the-loop learning to adapt dynamically to individual users and varying environments. Utilizes simulations in MuJoCo and Bayesian optimization techniques.

projects.name: How can a robot place an item on a cluttered desk?
projects.summary: Designed and implemented an intelligent approach for robotic item placement using Gazebo simulations and the Baxter robot. Optimized ROS Noetic compatibility and resolved integration challenges.

projects.name: Cart-Pole Swing-Up Control with JAX and MuJoCo
projects.summary: Developed controllers for the cart-pole swing-up task using classical methods and a neural network controller. Leveraged JAX, Equinox, and Diffrax for training and conducted real-time simulations with MuJoCo.

projects.name: SURover (Sabancı University Rover Team)
projects.summary: Led ROS-based simulations for robot arm control with MOVEIT, tested joystick and sensor functions on TurtleBots in Gazebo, and performed ArUco tag detection and fiducial SLAM using a Zed2 stereo camera. Contributed to mechanical design with SolidWorks and implemented motor control using Arduino for robust mobile robotics.
